mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions at 70 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School.
The City of Verona has released general election notices for the upcoming year, and the Plan Commission is currently reviewing a new site plan for the Sub-Zero project at Liberty Business Park.
There is plenty to do, starting with yoga tomorrow, followed by a busy Tuesday featuring trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.
On October 23, two thirteen-year-old juveniles were caught riding prohibited eMotos, resulting in citations for their parents.
Today's flavor, Mint Explosion, has come to an end. Join us tomorrow when we open at 10:00 AM to enjoy the Chocolate Volcano flavor of the day.
